about: Hand-made splits of speaker listings that the automatic rule (the organisation is after the last comma inside the brackets, newsroom/build/lib/derive.mjs parseSpeaker) gets wrong because the organisation itself holds a comma. Each entry names the listing exactly as the programme desk wrote it, the role and organisation it is, and why.

splits.as_listed: John Koetsier (Forbes columnist & Tech First Podcast Host, Forbes, Freelance)
splits.role: Forbes columnist & Tech First Podcast Host
splits.why: The team's data/events.json (read 1 November) gives the organisation as "Forbes, Freelance".

splits.as_listed: Vahan Agopyan (Secretary of Science, Technology and Innovation, Government of the State of Sao Paulo, Brazil)
splits.role: Secretary of Science, Technology and Innovation
splits.organisation: Government of the State of Sao Paulo, Brazil
splits.why: The team's data/events.json (read 1 November) gives the organisation as "Government of the State of Sao Paulo, Brazil"; "Brazil" alone is not the organisation.
